entries.name: Persecutor
entries.script: Persecutor. Attacks slow enemies based on how much mana they are missing. The slow starts at sixty percent mana, and reaches its maximum at zero mana. It has no effect if the enemy is above sixty percent mana.
entries.sourceText: Persecutor. Attacks slow enemies based on how much mana they are missing. Min slow at 60% mana, up to max slow at 0% mana. No effect if enemy is above 60% mana.
entries.sourceReviewNotes: Preserves the current 60% threshold and 0% maximum-slow endpoint.

entries.name: Marksmanship
entries.script: Marksmanship. Drow's experiences in battle grant her a chance to launch arrows with incredible accuracy and effectiveness. Pierces through the enemy's defenses, ignoring their base armor. This ability is disabled if there is an enemy hero within three hundred range.

entries.script: Necromastery. Shadow Fiend steals the soul from units he kills, gaining one bonus damage per soul. Hero kills grant four souls. On death, he releases thirty percent of them from bondage.

entries.name: Disperser
entries.script: Disperser. Active: Suppress. Dispels both the wearer and the target. Enemy targets are slowed for four seconds. Allied targets gain bonus movement speed and forty percent slow resistance for four seconds. The caster always receives the ally benefit on cast. The movement speed reduction and increase both start at one hundred percent and gradually decrease to zero percent over the buff's duration. Dispel type: basic dispel. Passive: Mana Break. Each attack burns forty mana from the target, and deals one physical damage per mana burned. Illusions do not burn mana.
entries.sourceText:
Disperser. Active: Suppress
 Dispels both the wearer and the target. Enemy targets are slowed for 4 seconds. Allied targets gain bonus movespeed and 40% slow resistance for 4 seconds. Caster is always granted the ally benefit on cast.

Both movement speed reduction and increase start at 100% and gradually decrease to 0% over the course of the buff duration.
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel

Passive: Manabreak
Each attack burns 40 mana from the target, and deals 1 physical damage per burned mana. 

Illusions do not burn mana.
entries.sourceReviewNotes: Preserves duration, slow resistance, ramp-down and the illusion exclusion; expands movespeed for clearer speech.

entries.name: Sacred Arrow
entries.script: Sacred Arrow. Fires a long-range arrow with deadly precision, which stuns and damages the first enemy unit it strikes. The stun starts at zero point zero one seconds. Its maximum duration is two point three, three point two, four point one, or five seconds, at ability levels one through four, respectively. Up to one hundred and eighty bonus damage is added, based on the distance the arrow travels to its target. It instantly kills the first non-ancient creep that it hits.
entries.sourceText: Sacred Arrow. Fires a long-range arrow with deadly precision, which stuns and damages the first enemy unit it strikes. The stun duration ranges from 0.01 to 2.3 / 3.2 / 4.1 / 5 seconds, with bonus damage up to 180 added, based on the distance the arrow travels to its target. Instantly kills the first non-ancient creep it hits.
entries.sourceReviewNotes: Expands the slash-separated maximum stun values into an explicit four-level list without changing the numbers.

entries.name: Bloodstone
entries.script: Bloodstone. Its active ability, Bloodpact, increases Bloodstone's spell lifesteal to sixty percent for five seconds. Its passive, Spell Weakness Aura, causes enemy units within twelve hundred range to take ten percent more damage from spells.
entries.sourceText:
Bloodstone. Active: Bloodpact
 Increases Bloodstone's Spell Lifesteal to 60%. Lasts 5 seconds. 

Passive: Spell Weakness Aura
 Enemy units take 10% increased damage from spells. 

Radius: 1200
entries.sourceReviewNotes: Preserves lifesteal as a total of 60%, not an additional 60%, and the 10% spell damage vulnerability.
